review_improvement: Exposes the three-way Rebuild/Present/Locate mismatch and defines a non-guessing path to per-drive recovery evidence.
independent_technical_reasoning: Rebuild, presence and locate indicators originate from different controller state machines. A rebuild requires degraded topology and replacement writes, so its risk and evidence cannot be derived from insertion or a management LED bit; an explicit branch decision and real progress telemetry are mandatory.
